{{Quote|You should judge that Jedi by what he does, not by rumors or morality tales.|Eppie Belden to Gaeriel Captison, about Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker|<ref name="The Truce at Bakura" />}}
'''Eppie Belden''', maiden name '''Eppie Antruse''', was a [[Bakuran]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Antruse family]] of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. She joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. With her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], [[Orn Belden]], she had a [[Parent/Legends|son]] named [[Roviden Belden]]. After Roviden and Eppie both aided the Rebellion, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilek Nereus]] ordered her son's [[Death/Legends|execution]] and her mind destroyed using a parasitic insect from the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]], causing her to live in a state resembling advanced senility; Orn was also eventually killed.

Belden was 132 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old by the time of the [[Bakura Incident]], during which the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to reverse her condition. Using her Bakuran underground contacts and her skills as a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], she initiated the Bakuran Revolution and personally captured Nereus.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Who are you, old woman?''"<br />"''Start guessing, youngster. I'm Orn Belden's revenge.''"<br />"''You can't be here, scarring of the neocortex is permanent.''"<br />"''Tell that to Commander Skywalker|Imperial Governor Wilek Nereus and Eppie Belden|<ref name="The Truce at Bakura" />}}
Eppie Antruse was a [[Bakuran]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was born in [[128 BBY]] as a member of the [[Antruse family]] of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. In [[97 BBY]], the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] uprising on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], she [[Marriage/Legends|married]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Belden]] and changed her name to Eppie Belden. Sometime afterward, they had their only child, [[Roviden Belden|Roviden]].

[[File:Eppie_Belden.png|thumb|right|160px|Eppie Belden]]
Along with her husband and son, Eppie sympathized with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Bakura was independent and neutral during the conflict until the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] annexed Bakura in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Roviden, who had become an agent of the Rebellion, was executed on order of Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilek Nereus]]; Eppie, who had also aided the Rebellion, was also ordered to be executed. Orn pleaded for her life, and Nereus agreed to grant it&mdash;but instead of killing her, Nereus destroyed her mind using a parasitic insect from the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]]. The price for Orn was the loss of his voice.

Eppie's condition, which resembled advanced senility, was incurable until the [[Invasion of Bakura]], when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to reverse the damage. She awoke to find that Nereus had killed her husband and arrested [[Prime Minister (Bakura)|Prime Minister]] [[Yeorg Captison]], and&mdash;using her contacts in the Bakuran underground and her skills as a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]]&mdash;initiated the Bakuran Revolution.

Despite her age, she personally captured Nereus, and like other revolutionaries, was in favor of trying him in a revolutionary tribunal. However, with the surrender of the Imperial garrison and the release of Prime Minister Captison, the revolutionaries deferred authority back to the [[Bakuran Senate]] and handed Nereus over to Skywalker.

==Personality and traits==
She had a personality that was described as "fiery," to match her hair, and was the first adult friend of [[Gaeriel Captison]].

==Skills and abilities==
Belden was skilled as a slicer.
